source.text: 7.3 For purposes of the agreed delivery arrangement, the delivery date relevant to the delay mechanism in this clause is 15 January 2027. The first seven (7) days of delay after that date shall be free of a delivery penalty. For each subsequent day of delay, the Vendor shall be liable to the Buyer for a penalty calculated at 0.5% of the invoice value, subject to an aggregate maximum of 5% of that invoice value.
6.1 The agreed unit price for an HP LaserJet Enterprise Printer is PKR 130,000 per unit, and no invoice issued by the Vendor may state a higher unit price for that product.
